steps: Stand beside a low, stable bench with a clear landing area. | Bend your knees slightly and swing your arms to prepare. | Hop over the bench and land softly on bent knees. | Reset your balance before the next hop. Choose a non-jumping alternative if needed.
setup: Only use a very stable, low step or bench that cannot slide; clear the floor around you. | Wear shoes with grip; skip this exercise on a slippery floor.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.
review_note: Động tác bật qua ghế: cần HLV duyệt chiều cao bục, mặt sàn và cách tiếp đất trước khi quay.

ten_viet: Nhón gót đứng bằng trọng lượng cơ thể
steps: Stand tall near a wall or rail for balance, feet hip-width apart. | Rise onto the balls of your feet by lifting your heels. | Pause for a moment at the top. | Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
setup: Hold a wall, chair back or door frame lightly for balance. | Stand on the edge of a stair for a bigger range once the floor version feels easy.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

ten_viet: Dead bug – duỗi tay/chân đối bên
steps: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and hips and knees bent at ninety degrees. | Gently press your lower back towards the floor and breathe out. | Slowly extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg forward. | Return to the start and repeat on the other side.
setup: Use a mat or carpet so your back is comfortable. | Move slowly; if your lower back lifts off the floor, reduce how far you reach.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

ten_viet: Đẩy ngực với tạ đơn trên ghế
steps: Lie on a flat, stable bench with feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand at chest level. | Press the dumbbells up above your chest without locking your elbows. | Lower the dumbbells slowly back to the sides of your chest. | Keep your shoulders and back supported on the bench throughout.
setup: You need a stable, flat bench and dumbbells; do not use a sofa or soft surface. | Without a bench, do a floor press: lie on a mat and press from the floor.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

ten_viet: Kéo tạ đơn khi gập hông
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips with a slight knee bend. | Keep your back steady and let your arms hang below your shoulders. | Pull the dumbbells towards your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Lower the dumbbells slowly without swinging.
setup: Use dumbbells or filled water bottles; keep a slight bend in your knees. | Rest one hand on a chair seat if you want extra back support (one-arm version).
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

ten_viet: Cuốn tay trước với tạ đơn
steps: Stand tall holding the dumbbells with your arms straight and palms facing forward. | Keep your elbows close to your sides. | Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders without swinging your body. | Lower them slowly back to the start.
setup: Use dumbbells or filled water bottles; stand with your back against a wall to stop swinging.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. | Take a controlled step forward into a comfortable split stance. | Bend both knees and lower your body, keeping your front heel on the floor. | Push through your front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.
setup: Clear a space about two steps long in front of you. | Hold a wall or chair for balance if needed.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms by your sides. | Tighten your stomach and glutes. | Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, without arching your lower back. | Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
setup: Use a mat on the floor; place your heels about a hand's length from your hips.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands slightly wider than your shoulders. | Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor. | Press back up to the start. Use a knee or wall push-up if you need an easier version.
setup: Place hands flat on the floor, fingers spread, directly under or slightly wider than your shoulders. | Use a mat for comfort; start with knee or wall push-ups if needed.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand tall in a clear space with your feet together. | Step forward into a lunge, bending both knees with control. | Push through your front foot and bring your back foot forward to stand. | Continue forward, alternating legs at a steady pace.
setup: You need a clear hallway or room length; walk in a straight line.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out. | Push your hips back and bend your knees as if sitting into a chair. | Lower within a comfortable range, keeping your chest up and heels down. | Push through your feet to stand tall again.
setup: Place a chair behind you as a target and safety: lightly touch it and stand up. | Keep your weight across your whole foot, not only the toes.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders. | Step your feet back and rest on your toes. | Keep a straight line from shoulders to heels and tighten your stomach. | Breathe normally and hold for the planned time.
setup: Use a mat or carpet under your forearms. | Look at the floor between your hands to keep your neck long.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Lie on your side with your elbow directly under your shoulder. | Stack your feet or place the top foot in front for balance. | Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line. | Hold while breathing, then change sides.
setup: Use a mat; bend your knees for an easier version.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. | Keep your back flat and your hips level. | Slowly extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back. | Return to the start and switch sides.
setup: Use a mat; place a cushion under your knees if needed.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand facing a stable wall and place your palms on it at chest height. | Step your feet back a little so your body leans forward in a straight line. | Bend your elbows to bring your chest towards the wall. | Press back to the start with control.
setup: Place hands on the wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing up. | The further your feet are from the wall, the harder it becomes.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Start on your hands and knees, then walk your hands forward until your body is straight from knees to shoulders. | Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders. | Bend your elbows to lower your chest between your hands. | Press back up without letting your hips sag.
setup: Put a folded towel or mat under your knees. | Hands a little wider than shoulders, fingers forward.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Sit or stand tall holding a dumbbell beside each shoulder. | Tighten your stomach to keep your back steady. | Press the dumbbells overhead within a comfortable range. | Lower them slowly back to shoulder level.
setup: Use light dumbbells or water bottles; sit on a sturdy chair with back support if standing is hard.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand tall with light dumbbells at your sides and a soft bend in your elbows. | Raise your arms out to the sides up to about shoulder height. | Pause briefly at the top without shrugging. | Lower slowly without swinging.
setup: Use very light dumbbells or water bottles; lighter is better here.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Anchor the band securely at chest height and check it is safe. | Hold the ends and step back until the band is slightly tight. | Pull your elbows back close to your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades. | Return slowly to the start.
setup: Anchor the band in a closed door with a door anchor or around a sturdy post. | Check the band for cracks before every session.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips. | Soften your knees slightly. | Push your hips back while keeping your back straight, letting your torso lean forward. | Bring your hips forward to stand tall without leaning back.
setup: Hold a broomstick along your back touching head, upper back and tailbone to learn a straight back.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand facing a low, stable step. | Place your whole foot on the step. | Step up with control and bring your other foot up. | Step down slowly one foot at a time, then change the leading leg.
setup: Use the bottom stair or a very stable, low step; hold the handrail.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand tall with relaxed shoulders. | Lift one knee gently, then the other, marching in place. | Swing your arms naturally and breathe easily. | Keep the pace comfortable; this is a warm-up.
setup: Any clear space works; march on a carpet or mat to reduce impact.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it for support. | Step one foot back and keep that leg straight. | Gently press the back heel towards the floor until you feel a stretch in the calf. | Hold without bouncing, then switch sides.
setup: Use a wall or door frame for support.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand or sit comfortably with relaxed shoulders. | Breathe in slowly through your nose. | Breathe out slowly and fully. | Continue calmly until your breathing returns to normal.
setup: Sit or stand anywhere quiet.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Sit tall near the front of a stable chair or bench with feet flat. | Lift one knee a little while keeping your back upright. | Lower it with control. | Alternate legs at a steady pace without leaning back.
setup: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand with your back against a stable wall and feet about a step away from it. | Slide down until your knees are comfortably bent. | Keep your back against the wall and breathe normally. | Hold, then slide back up to stand. Stop if it becomes uncomfortable.
setup: Use a smooth wall; place a mat under your feet so they do not slide.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand tall next to a stable support. | Lift your heels slightly so you balance on the balls of your feet. | Hold the position steadily without gripping your toes. | Lower your heels slowly when the time is up.
setup: Stand next to a wall, counter or chair back.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.
review_note: ID cũ ghi heel-walk nhưng nhãn hiện tại là heel raise. Chốt rõ nhón gót hay đi bằng gót với HLV trước khi quay.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. | Place your hands lightly beside your head or across your chest. | Breathe out and lift your shoulders off the floor using your stomach muscles. | Lower slowly back down.
setup: Use a mat; keep your chin slightly tucked and do not pull on your neck.
mistakes: Pulling on the neck with the hands. | Sitting all the way up quickly.

steps: Lie face down with arms stretched forward and legs straight. | Look at the floor to keep your neck long. | Gently lift your arms, chest and legs a little off the floor. | Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.
setup: Use a mat; lift only a small height without pain.
mistakes: Lifting too high and straining the lower back. | Holding the breath.

steps: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing your body. | Keep your elbows close to your sides. | Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, keeping palms facing in. | Lower slowly to the start.
setup: Use dumbbells or filled water bottles; stand against a wall to stop swinging.
mistakes: Swinging the body. | Letting elbows move forward.

steps: Sit on the edge of a stable bench or chair and place your hands beside your hips. | Slide your hips off the edge with knees bent and feet flat. | Bend your elbows to lower your body a little, elbows pointing back. | Press up until your arms are straight.
setup: Use a sturdy chair against a wall so it cannot slide; keep knees bent for an easier version.
mistakes: Going too low and straining the shoulders. | Elbows flaring out.

ten_viet: Đẩy ngực tạ đơn trên ghế dốc
steps: Set the bench to a low incline and sit back with a dumbbell on each thigh. | Lie back and bring the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, palms facing forward. | Press the dumbbells up until your arms are almost straight above your chest. | Lower them slowly back to the sides of your chest.
setup: At home, do incline push-ups with hands on a sturdy table.
mistakes: Bench set too steep, turning it into a shoulder press. | Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.

steps: Place one knee and one hand on a bench with your back flat. | Hold a dumbbell with your upper arm close to your side and your elbow bent. | Straighten your elbow to move the dumbbell back until your arm is straight. | Bend your elbow slowly to return, then switch arms after the set.
setup: At home, use a water bottle or a band.
mistakes: Swinging the upper arm. | Rounding the back.

ten_viet: Duỗi tay sau với tạ qua đầu
steps: Sit or stand tall and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head. | Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head. | Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell slowly behind your head. | Straighten your arms to lift it back up.
setup: At home, use a water bottle or a light dumbbell.
mistakes: Elbows flaring wide. | Arching the lower back.

ten_viet: Nâng tạ vai sau khi gập hông
steps: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back. | Let your arms hang below your shoulders with a slight bend in the elbows. | Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders. | Lower slowly and repeat.
setup: At home, use water bottles or a band.
mistakes: Using heavy weights and swinging. | Rounding the back.
